plain: A voluntary EU rulebook that AI developers can sign to show they meet the AI Act's duties for general-purpose models.
eli5: A checklist the teacher hands out: follow it and you have shown you did your homework properly.
technical: The General-Purpose AI Code of Practice (2025), a voluntary instrument with Transparency, Copyright and Safety and Security chapters; adherence is a way for providers to demonstrate compliance with Articles 53 and 55 of the EU AI Act.
